label: g1152-smoke
_why: THE POST-PATCH SMOKE TEST of the game 1.15.2 pass (ON_GAME_UPDATE §1 step 9; GAME_UPDATE_1_15_2.md W43, Q3). The user's go-ahead, 2026-11-19: "Sure, as soon as we're done with the decisions" (the decisions made the same hour: the canon stays 697d4869, the replay on 1.15.2 reproducing it but for two record labels, W42; vanilla's AI changes pass through, the company-target define 5 -> 20 included, Q2 (a)). Mod 1.1.2 is a compatibility patch: the 1.1.1 canon rebuilt on 1.15.2. A SYNTAX PROBE in the sense of BALANCE_FRAMEWORK §10.118: it checks that the build loads and runs on the new game, and it is never economy data. Three runs: the canon and a control to 1846, and a second control to 1836.4.1 with monthly autosaves whose 1836.2.1 save refreshes config/measured_1836_pop_identity.json (W14; the 1.15 pass did the same, session 20261108_061520 run 3).
